title: Golden Hour Glow
subtitle: Mastering the warmth of natural light in cinematic portraiture.

poseTips.title: Lens Flare Control
poseTips.description: Position the sun partially behind the subject to create beautiful rays without losing detail.

poseTips.title: Golden Skin Tones
poseTips.description: Adjust white balance slightly towards the warm side to enhance the sunset glow.

title: The Noir Aesthetic
subtitle: Exploring high-contrast shadows and minimalist studio compositions.

poseTips.title: Rembrandt Lighting
poseTips.description: Position your light at a 45-degree angle to create the classic light triangle on the cheek.

poseTips.title: Negative Space
poseTips.description: Use deep shadows to frame the subject and draw focus to the eyes.

title: City Neon Dreams
subtitle: Capturing the vibrant energy of night-time urban environments.

poseTips.title: Slow Shutter Motion
poseTips.description: Use a slightly slower shutter speed to capture background movement while keeping the subject sharp.

poseTips.title: Color Contrast
poseTips.description: Find neon signs with complementary colors (e.g., blue and orange) to make the image pop.

title: Modern Vibrancy
subtitle: A bold take on traditional fashion covers with avant-garde styling.

poseTips.title: Bold Expressions
poseTips.description: Encourage the subject to use strong, non-traditional facial expressions to match the high-fashion vibe.

poseTips.title: Styling Focal Point
poseTips.description: Identify the key piece of clothing or accessory and ensure it is highlighted by the lighting.
